top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as 30-Year Bond Yields Surge After Fed | The Close 7/29/2026
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Ken Shinoda, DoubleLine Capital Portfolio Manager, Alexandra Wilson-Elizondo, Goldman Sachs Global Co-Head of Multi-Asset Solutions, Rishi Jaluria, RBC Capital Markets Managing Director of Software Equity Research, Ygal Arounian, Wedbush Managing Director of Internet Equity Research, Abby Roach, Allspring Global Investments Senior Portfolio Analyst, and Richard Francis, Teva Pharmaceutical CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks to Fall as Fed Keeps Rates on Hold: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set to track Wall Street lower after renewed concerns over artificial intelligence spending and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook sent longer-dated Treasury yields to their highest levels in almost two decades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
